The morph state-table fields now use `MorphStateTable` instead of `STXHeader`. Its `write` method selects the legacy `StateHeader` for `"morx"` as well as `"mort"`, so a compilable morx state table can now use legacy encodings (such as 16-bit header offsets and byte-sized state-array entries) instead of the original extended encoding, producing different bytes for the same objects.
